hook.evidence: Introduces the need for efficient multicasting in 5G/6G mmWave and sub-THz networks.

gap.evidence: Notes absence of comprehensive surveys spanning definitions, system models, optimization, technologies, and future directions for multicasting.

yes_but.evidence: Acknowledges prior studies but highlights missing unified view across RATs and enhancement technologies.

contribution.evidence: Lists contributions covering cellular multicast support, types/use cases/metrics, models, optimal solutions, technologies, and future research.

scope_boundary.evidence: Scope spans definitions, RAT-specific support, types/use cases/metrics, models, optimization, technologies, and future challenges.

rhetorical_moves_global.reader_contract_pattern: Motivate multicasting; review 4G/5G support; classify types/use cases/metrics; present component models; survey optimal solutions; summarize lessons; list enhancement technologies; outline future research; provide glossary.

axes: Enhancement technologies (sidelink, RIS, NTN, edge, AI/ML, caching, cell-free, C/F-RAN, network coding, NOMA)

visuals_tables.layout_logic: Figures/tables illustrate definitions/support, models, optimization comparisons, and technology enhancements; lessons/future directions more text-heavy.

figures.purpose: depict multicasting system components and RAT integration

tables.purpose: summarize algorithms/metrics or comparison of solutions

lesson_blocks.lesson: RAT-specific capabilities and metrics shape feasible multicasting deployments.
Antenna/blockage/propagation models anchor realistic optimization assumptions.
Single-/multi-RAT optimizations trade complexity and performance; alternatives mitigate execution time.
Sidelink, RIS, NTN, edge, AI/ML, caching, and coding provide orthogonal levers to improve multicast performance.
Future work targets mobility, IAB support, reliability, coexistence, ML, and beam squint-aware hybrid beamforming.

synthesis.aha_moment: Layering RAT support, use cases/metrics, component models, optimization solutions, and enhancement technologies turns a broad multicasting space into parallel, comparable tracks with clear future gaps.

style.section_openers_pattern: Introduce domain then enumerate subtopics with figures/tables; frequent lists and equations.

reusable_writing_recipes.title: Intro with challenges and survey comparison
steps: List challenges and compare with prior studies.
reusable_writing_recipes.why_it_works: Sets novelty and scope before technical content.

reusable_writing_recipes.title: Types/use cases/metrics before models and optimization
steps: Classify types, deployment options, use cases, and metrics.
Then introduce component models to ground later optimizations.
reusable_writing_recipes.why_it_works: Aligns requirements and metrics before modeling and optimization.

reusable_writing_recipes.title: Parallel optimization across RAT counts
steps: Separate single-RAT, dual-RAT, and multi-RAT optimization methods.
Include alternative solutions for complexity/latency trade-offs.
reusable_writing_recipes.why_it_works: Parallel treatment clarifies trade-offs across RAT configurations.

reusable_writing_recipes.title: Technology enhancements then future agenda
steps: List enhancement technologies (sidelink, RIS, NTN, edge, AI/ML, caching, cell-free, C/F-RAN, coding, NOMA).
Follow with future directions mapped to technical gaps (mobility, IAB, reliability, coexistence, beamforming, ML).
reusable_writing_recipes.why_it_works: Connects current enhancement levers to a targeted research roadmap.

notes: Counts heuristic; numerous figures, equations, and tables across optimization and enhancement sections. Acronym list at end acts as glossary.
